# IconButton

A round 48px icon button, like the search and heart buttons in the music-app reference.

`Gathr.IconButton` · Actions

## Use

```jsx
<Gathr.IconButton icon={…} label="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="Gathr.IconButton" icon="{{…}}" label="…"></x-import>
```

## Props (IconButtonProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `icon` * | `IconName` |  |
| `label` * | `string` |  |
| `variant` | `'glass' \| 'solid' \| 'scrim' \| 'tonal'` |  |
| `size` | `number` |  |
| `active` | `boolean` |  |

_Also accepts: React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>._
